{{Quote|Beings of Cularin, let the galaxy bear witness to your weakness, and to my revenge.|Mebara Jos|<ref name="Cloak and Vibroblade" />}}
'''Mebara Jos''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Togorian/Legends|Togorian]] who lived during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Due to her [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitivity]], Jos was shunned by her own people, so she eventually left them and attempted to enroll at the [[Almas Academy]], a [[Jedi academy]] that was located in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]]. However, the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] refused her entry into the academy, and she left the [[Star system/Legends|system]], vowing to have revenge against those who had spurned her. Jos founded the [[Fireclaw Horde]], a Togorian criminal gang, and twenty years after her rejection by the Jedi, she returned to the Cularin system, determined to have vengeance against the system's inhabitants. However, her first two attempts at [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]] attacks, a scheme to capture the [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]]-[[Carbon-freezing/Legends|frozen]] Jedi [[Ji-Ad Sarain]] and a raid on the [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liner]] ''[[Queen of Cularin]]'', were unsuccessful. As a final, desperate act, Jos planned to stage an attack on the [[Cularin Classic]], a [[Swoop racing/Legends|swoop race]] that was set to take place on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]]. During the race, she [[Jammer/Legends|jammed]] the controls of a [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]] that was being used by [[Team SoroSuub]], one of the competing teams, sending the vehicle hurtling toward a crowd of spectators. A group of [[Heroes of Cularin|freelance agents]] prevented the bike from making contact with the crowd, enraging Jos and causing her to attack them using the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]]. However, they eventually defeated her.

==Biography==
===Early life===
Mebara Jos was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Togorian/Legends|Togorian]] who was born during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="Cloak and Vibroblade" /> Most Togorians despised and mistrusted those among their [[Species/Legends|species]] who could use [[The Force/Legends|the Force]],<ref name="Ultimate Alien Anthology">''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]''</ref> and as a result, Jos was shunned by her own people. She eventually left them and traveled to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Almas]] in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]], planning to enroll at the [[Almas Academy]], a [[Jedi academy]] that was located on the world. However, after Jos got into a fight with another prospective [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], the academy's application team refused her entry into the institute. She did not take the rejection well and responded by attacking some of her fellow candidates.<ref name="Cloak and Vibroblade" />

Jos left the Cularin [[Star system/Legends|system]] and disappeared, swearing to have vengeance against both other Togorians and the Almas Academy. Over the next twenty years, the scope of her hatred enlarged to encompass the entire populations of the Cularin system and [[Togoria/Legends|Togoria]],<ref name="Cloak and Vibroblade" /> the Togorian [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]].<ref name="Ultimate Alien Anthology" /> She began using the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]], training herself to utilize a number of [[Force power/Legends|Force powers]], and at some point, she founded the [[Fireclaw Horde]], a criminal gang that was made up entirely of Togorians.<ref name="Cloak and Vibroblade" /> However, her gang failed at nearly every job that they tried to pull off.<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|II|174|Jos, Mebara}}</ref>

===Return to the Cularin system===
Circa [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="20 BBY">The ''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]'' states that the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|''Living Force'']] campaign is set one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] after the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], an event that is dated to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] by ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. As the ''Living Force'' adventure ''[[Below the Belt: Philology|Philology]]'' [[Cularin's disappearance|moved]] the campaign forward ten years to the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], and the adventure ''[[Night Eyes: Night's Homecoming|Night's Homecoming]]'' established that by Year 4 of the campaign over a year had elapsed since the events of ''Philology'', ''[[Jigsaw: Cloak and Vibroblade|Cloak and Vibroblade]]'' can therefore be dated to circa [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]].</ref> during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Jos returned to the Cularin system, determined to enact retribution against the the system's inhabitants.<ref name="Cloak and Vibroblade" /> The Fireclaw Horde established a base in the abandoned [[City/Legends|city]] [[Nub Saar]] on [[Genarius]],<ref name="In the Name of the Maker">{{LivingForce|Jigsaw: In the Name of the Maker}}</ref> the system's third planet,<ref name="LFCG">''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]''</ref> and Jos masterminded a plot for the Horde to aide the [[Slavery/Legends|slaver]] [[Gomalo]] in the recovery of the [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]]-[[Carbon-freezing/Legends|frozen]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Ji-Ad Sarain]].<ref name="Portrait of the Artist">{{LivingForce|Jigsaw: Portrait of the Artist as a Young Rodian}}</ref><ref name="Cloak and Vibroblade" /> However, the mission was thwarted by the actions of the [[Heroes of Cularin]], a group of freelance agents who operated in the Cularin system, and the Horde was unsuccessful at retrieving the Jedi.<ref name="Portrait of the Artist" /> Jos subsequently launched another operation aimed at bringing her revenge, scheming to destroy the [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liner]] ''[[Queen of Cularin]]'',<ref name="Cloak and Vibroblade" /> and the Fireclaw Horde sent a [[ILH-KK Citadel-class civilian cruiser|''Citadel''-class cruiser]] and some [[MMR-9]] [[Droid/Legends|droids]] to attack the liner.<ref name="In the Name of the Maker" /> The Heroes of Cularin defeated the raiders, foiling Jos's plans for a second time.<ref name="Cloak and Vibroblade" /><ref name="In the Name of the Maker" />

In the aftermath of her failures, Jos developed another strategy for gaining revenge and began planning an attack on the [[Cularin Classic]] [[Swoop racing/Legends|swoop racing]] event. The race was scheduled to take place in the [[Cularin Repulsor Speedway]] stadium on the planet [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]], and was set to receive large-scale media coverage, so Jos believed that a violent attack on the competition would allow her to strike a blow against the citizens of the Cularin system. Using information stolen from a [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]] [[SoroSuub Gadrin office|office]] in the Cularin city of [[Gadrin]], she intended to [[Jammer/Legends|jam]] the controls of an [[XB-01 Speeder Bike]] that was to be fielded by [[Team SoroSuub]], one of the teams taking part in the race, and send the vehicle careening into the crowd watching the race. Because her previous operations had given Togorians too much exposure in the system, she had some of her Horde minions disguise themselves as [[Duckonian]]s, a made-up [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] species, and she entered a team of "Duckonians" in the race. She also began researching the other teams that were competing.<ref name="Cloak and Vibroblade" />

The [[Talons]] [[Swoop gang/Legends|swoop gang]], which was also participating in the race, hired the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] investigator [[Di'hal'uma]] to investigate its rival teams, and she soon deduced that the Duckonian team consisted of members of the Fireclaw Horde. Jos learned of the Twi'lek's investigation, and, via an intermediary called [[Jax (street punk)|Jax]], she hired a group of [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] thugs and the [[Blood Raptors]] swoop gang, ordering the Raptors to attempt to capture Di'hal'uma while the thugs created a distraction.<ref name="Cloak and Vibroblade" />

The race went ahead as planned, and during the event, Jos activated a jamming device when the SoroSuub [[Speeder bike/Legends|bike]] was aimed at the crowd. The machine disrupted all communications in the vicinity of the stadium, except for a media feed that was being broadcast to the rest of the Cularin system, and, while the vehicle hurtled toward the spectators, Jos's image appeared on the stadium's [[Viewscreen/Legends|viewscreens]]. She spoke to the crowd and then disabled a [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shield]] that was protecting them, while some of her minions simultaneously launched an attack against the onlookers.<ref name="Cloak and Vibroblade" /> However, the Heroes of Cularin were able to prevent the bike from hitting the crowd, driving Jos into a rage. She tapped into the dark side of the Force,<ref name="TCSWE" /> using it to [[Battlemind|increase her fighting spirit]] and enhance her abilities, before attacking the agents.<ref name="Cloak and Vibroblade" /> However, they eventually defeated Jos and her minions.<ref name="TCSWE" />

==Personality and traits==
The Jedi application team that refused Jos entry into the Almas Academy believed that she had too much anger and that rage was her primary motivation for applying to study at the academy.<ref name="Cloak and Vibroblade" /> However, their rejection of her caused Jos to become frustrated, because both the Jedi and her own people had spurned her.<ref name="TCSWE" /> This led to her eventually developing a hatred for the entire populations of Togoria and the Cularin system, and the failure of her plots to recover Ji-Ad Sarain and attack the ''Queen of Cularin'' intensified her loathing for the inhabitants of the Cularin system. Due to her failures, her plan to attack the Cularin Classic was born out of desperation, because she viewed it as her final chance to gain revenge,<ref name="Cloak and Vibroblade" /> and she hoped that the destruction she caused would be broadcast throughout the system.<ref name="TCSWE" /> She aimed to cause as much chaos and terror as possible during her attack by hurting and [[Death/Legends|killing]] a large number of people, which she believed would give her the best chance for escaping from the confrontation.<ref name="Cloak and Vibroblade" />

==Powers and abilities==
Jos trained herself to be able to use a number of Force powers, relating to both the control and alter aspects of the Force. She knew how to use the battlemind ability<ref name="Cloak and Vibroblade" /> to increase her concentration,<ref name="Core Rulebook">''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Core Rulebook]]''</ref> as well as using the Enhance Ability skill<ref name="Cloak and Vibroblade" /> to increase her strength,<ref name="Core Rulebook" /> and the [[Tutaminis|Drain Energy]] power<ref name="Cloak and Vibroblade" /> to resist the effects of attacks from energy weapons.<ref name="Core Rulebook" /> Like all Togorians, Jos could see twice as far in dim light as most other sentient beings could.<ref name="Cloak and Vibroblade" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|I must have gotten somebody worried, or they wouldn't have tried to grab me. Maybe they thought I know more than I do.|Di'haluma, on Jos's attempt to have the investigator captured, if the player characters save Di'hal'uma from the Blood Raptors|<ref name="Cloak and Vibroblade" />}}
Mebara Jos was created by [[Nate Christen|Nathanael Christen]] and appeared in ''[[Jigsaw: Cloak and Vibroblade]]'', a [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game|roleplaying]] [[Roleplaying game|adventure]] that formed part of the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|''Living Force'']] campaign.<ref name="Cloak and Vibroblade" /> She later received an entry in the [[2008]] book ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''.<ref name="TCSWE" /> In ''Cloak and Vibroblade'', the actions of the player characters, who roleplay as the Heroes of Cularin, can affect Jos's actions. If the players fail to stop the Blood Raptors from capturing Di'hal'uma, then Jos rendezvous with the Raptors on the edge of the Cularin jungle, and the criminals hand the Twi'lek over to her. Later in the adventure, it is possible for the player characters to prevent the SoroSuub speeder bike from crashing into the crowd watching the Cularin Classic, and, if they do so, Jos attacks them using the dark side of the Force.<ref name="Cloak and Vibroblade" /> Jos's entry in ''The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia'' confirms that the Heroes of Cularin prevented the crash, thus making the Togorian's attack on them the outcome that occurs in [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continutiy.<ref name="TCSWE" />
